courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的鐵道與交通設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring railway and transport systems through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 洛杉磯區域連接線
related.transfer: 可遷移「控制網與獨立量測殘差」與「月台暫存與隊列守恆」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；洛杉磯區域連接線的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Survey control and independent residuals" and "Platform storage and queue conservation" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Los Angeles Regional Connector must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦深層都市地鐵建設沉陷與垂直交通；洛杉磯區域連接線則以市中心輕軌連通線路網重整與轉乘為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on deep urban subway construction settlement and vertical circulation; Los Angeles Regional Connector centres on downtown light rail connector network reconfiguration and transfers, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「控制網與獨立量測殘差」與「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到洛杉磯區域連接線，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「集水與排水容量」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Survey control and independent residuals” and “Transfer walking and connection margin”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Los Angeles Regional Connector, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Catchment inflow and drainage capacity", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 紐約第二大道地鐵一期
history.text: 公開工程與出版時間線：2007 年：第二大道地鐵一期進入隧道建設階段；2017 年：第二大道地鐵一期於元旦開放旅客服務。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以紐約第二大道地鐵一期為背景，建立密集街廓下方新站與既有線銜接的教學剖面。課程把測量、灌漿、施工時間窗口及乘客垂直交通結合，要求分開施工變形控制和營運期人流驗證，並保留不確定度。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。
history.textEn: Public engineering and publication chronology: 2007: Second Avenue Subway Phase 1 entered its tunnel construction phase; 2017: Second Avenue Subway Phase 1 opened to passengers on New Year’s Day. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use Second Avenue Subway Phase 1 to construct a teaching section with new stations beneath dense city blocks and a connection to an existing line. Combine surveying, grouting, possession windows and vertical passenger movement. Keep construction-movement control distinct from operational passenger-flow validation, and retain uncertainty rather than treating one instrument reading as a complete statement about building or station performance. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.
